g.desc: CN3163 linear solar Li-ion charger behind a 5V input limiter: up to 4 solar panels (diode OR) -> 1S LiPo (4.2V)

g.text: INA3221 I2C power monitor (0x42): battery and total solar

g.text: - Solar inputs J1-J4: up to four 5V panels in parallel, each isolated by a 1N5819W (SOD-123, 40V/1A). Up to 0.5A per input.

g.desc: - Solar inputs J1-J4: up to four 5V panels in parallel, each isolated by a 1N5819W (SOD-123, 40V/1A). Up to 0.5A per input.

g.text: - U3 LDL1117S50R (5.0V LDO, 2.6-18V in, 20V abs max) limits the charger's supply VCHG to 5.0V: every CN3163 pin has a 6.5V absolute maximum,

g.desc: - U3 LDL1117S50R (5.0V LDO, 2.6-18V in, 20V abs max) limits the charger's supply VCHG to 5.0V: every CN3163 pin has a 6.5V absolute maximum,

g.text: and panels float to their open-circuit voltage once the battery is full. While charging U3 is in dropout (about 0.3R: ~70mV at 0.25A,

g.desc: and panels float to their open-circuit voltage once the battery is full. While charging U3 is in dropout (about 0.3R: ~70mV at 0.25A,

g.text: ~0.25V at 0.8A). Panels up to 18V open-circuit are safe; above 5-6V nominal the extra voltage is only burnt off as heat in U3 and U1.

g.desc: ~0.25V at 0.8A). Panels up to 18V open-circuit are safe; above 5-6V nominal the extra voltage is only burnt off as heat in U3 and U1.

g.text: C1 10uF/25V on U3's input, C2 10uF on its output at U1 (datasheet: 1uF in, 4.7uF out, ceramic). The LEDs run from VCHG as well.

g.desc: C1 10uF/25V on U3's input, C2 10uF on its output at U1 (datasheet: 1uF in, 4.7uF out, ceramic). The LEDs run from VCHG as well.

g.text: - U1 CN3163: linear CC/CV charger, 4.2V 1%. No inductor, pass FET, sense resistor or MPPT divider. When the panels can't supply the

g.desc: - U1 CN3163: linear CC/CV charger, 4.2V 1%. No inductor, pass FET, sense resistor or MPPT divider. When the panels can't supply the

g.text: set current it cuts the charge current to hold VCHG at 4.4V or above, so each panel sits ~0.4-0.6V higher (diode + U3), near its Vmp.

g.desc: set current it cuts the charge current to hold VCHG at 4.4V or above, so each panel sits ~0.4-0.6V higher (diode + U3), near its Vmp.

g.text: - Charge current: ICH = 1188V / R2 = 1188 / 1.5k = 0.79A, leaving margin on the 1.0A connector contacts (R2 = 2.4k for 0.5A).

g.desc: - Charge current: ICH = 1188V / R2 = 1188 / 1.5k = 0.79A, leaving margin on the 1.0A connector contacts (R2 = 2.4k for 0.5A).

g.text: Precharge at 10% below 2.94V (70% of 4.2V); terminates at 10% of ICH; recharges automatically. Die limited to ~130C by thermal regulation:

g.desc: Precharge at 10% below 2.94V (70% of 4.2V); terminates at 10% of ICH; recharges automatically. Die limited to ~130C by thermal regulation:

g.text: dissipation is (VCHG - VBAT) x ICH, about 0.55W at VCHG 4.4V / 3.7V cell / 0.79A, up to ~1W at 5.0V, so the current may fold back.

g.desc: dissipation is (VCHG - VBAT) x ICH, about 0.55W at VCHG 4.4V / 3.7V cell / 0.79A, up to ~1W at 5.0V, so the current may fold back.

g.text: - FB tied to BAT at the VBAT node (no Rx). Exposed pad (pin 9) soldered to GND.

g.desc: - FB tied to BAT at the VBAT node (no Rx). Exposed pad (pin 9) soldered to GND.

g.text: - TEMP (datasheet Figure 7): R3 4.7k VCHG -> TEMP, R4 47k TEMP -> GND, TH1 10k B3950 NTC across R4. Charging runs while TEMP is

g.desc: - TEMP (datasheet Figure 7): R3 4.7k VCHG -> TEMP, R4 47k TEMP -> GND, TH1 10k B3950 NTC across R4. Charging runs while TEMP is

g.text: 45-80% of VCHG: about 1 to 46C. JP2 is bridged by a trace and holds TEMP at GND (sensing off, R3 draws ~1mA from VCHG). Its pads are

g.desc: 45-80% of VCHG: about 1 to 46C. JP2 is bridged by a trace and holds TEMP at GND (sensing off, R3 draws ~1mA from VCHG). Its pads are

g.text: TH1's solder pads: cut the trace, then wire the NTC (off-board, against the cell) to them. With JP2 cut and no NTC the charger won't start.

g.desc: TH1's solder pads: cut the trace, then wire the NTC (off-board, against the cell) to them. With JP2 cut and no NTC the charger won't start.

g.text: - C3 10uF on BAT (datasheet: 1uF typical, 1-22uF ceramic stable). No blocking diode needed: under 3uA from the

g.desc: - C3 10uF on BAT (datasheet: 1uF typical, 1-22uF ceramic stable). No blocking diode needed: under 3uA from the

g.text: battery when the input is dark. D5-D8 are there to keep a shaded panel from loading the others.

g.desc: battery when the input is dark. D5-D8 are there to keep a shaded panel from loading the others.

g.text: - Status: D4 red ON = charging, D3 green ON = charge done. Both off = no input, VIN < VBAT, or JP1 cut.

g.desc: - Status: D4 red ON = charging, D3 green ON = charge done. Both off = no input, VIN < VBAT, or JP1 cut.

g.text: - Power connectors J1-J6 are 2-pin Micro JST 1.25 / PicoBlade-compatible (1.0A per contact); J9 I2C is the 4-pin version.

g.desc: - Power connectors J1-J6 are 2-pin Micro JST 1.25 / PicoBlade-compatible (1.0A per contact); J9 I2C is the 4-pin version.

g.text: J7/J8 are 2.54mm pin headers for panel-mount SPST switches, or a jumper cap if unused. J1-J6 share one type, so check the silkscreen before plugging in.

g.desc: J7/J8 are 2.54mm pin headers for panel-mount SPST switches, or a jumper cap if unused. J1-J6 share one type, so check the silkscreen before plugging in.

g.text: Polarity: J1-J6 pin 1 = +, pin 2 = GND. The board marks + and - at each of these connectors. Q2 blocks a reversed cell on J5.

g.desc: Polarity: J1-J6 pin 1 = +, pin 2 = GND. The board marks + and - at each of these connectors. Q2 blocks a reversed cell on J5.

g.text: J7 SW_BATT isolates the cell from charger and load. J8 SW_LOAD switches only VOUT (J6), so the cell keeps charging with it off.

g.desc: J7 SW_BATT isolates the cell from charger and load. J8 SW_LOAD switches only VOUT (J6), so the cell keeps charging with it off.

g.text: Rate both switches >= 1A or the module's peak current, whichever is higher (battery current is charge OR load, not the sum).

g.desc: Rate both switches >= 1A or the module's peak current, whichever is higher (battery current is charge OR load, not the sum).

g.text: With SW_BATT off in sun the CN3163 sees no battery and holds VBAT near 4.2V: keep SW_LOAD off then.

g.desc: With SW_BATT off in sun the CN3163 sees no battery and holds VBAT near 4.2V: keep SW_LOAD off then.

g.text: - INA3221 (U2, I2C 0x42: A0 = SDA, the Meshtastic and MeshCore default). CH1 = R6 battery (BATT+ -> cell), + charging / - discharging;

g.desc: - INA3221 (U2, I2C 0x42: A0 = SDA, the Meshtastic and MeshCore default). CH1 = R6 battery (BATT+ -> cell), + charging / - discharging;

g.text: CH2 = R7 solar total (PV -> VIN); CH3 unused (IN+3/IN-3 tied to GND). Bus voltage is read at each IN- pin: cell, VIN.

g.desc: CH2 = R7 solar total (PV -> VIN); CH3 unused (IN+3/IN-3 tied to GND). Bus voltage is read at each IN- pin: cell, VIN.

g.text: All shunts 0.1R, as both firmwares assume: +/-163.8mV full scale = +/-1.64A, 0.4mA steps. Alert outputs unused; VPU tied to VS.

g.desc: All shunts 0.1R, as both firmwares assume: +/-163.8mV full scale = +/-1.64A, 0.4mA steps. Alert outputs unused; VPU tied to VS.

g.text: J9 to MCU: 1 VCC_MCU (3.3-5V, powers U2 and pull-ups), 2 GND, 3 SCL, 4 SDA. R8/R9 10k pull-ups: omit if the MCU board has them.

g.desc: J9 to MCU: 1 VCC_MCU (3.3-5V, powers U2 and pull-ups), 2 GND, 3 SCL, 4 SDA. R8/R9 10k pull-ups: omit if the MCU board has them.
